episodes.211272: An approaching low pressure over northwest Ontario draped a stationary front over Lake Superior on the 24th and a tightening pressure gradient forced wind gusts in excess of storm force.

events.county: Manitou Island To Marquette Mi And W Of Grand Marais Mi To Us/Canadian Border Beyond 5Nm Of Shore
events.narrative: The C-MAN Station STDM4 Stannard Rock Lighthouse reported wind gusts of over 55 mph from 8:50 AM to 11:40 AM on the 24th, including a peak wind gust of 62 mph at 11 AM.
